title: sdd.config.json
description: Configuration for the spec-driven development framework tools.

frameworkVersion.description: Framework version the repository was set up with.

scope.description: Default organizational scope (a key in the scope map) for documents without scope_name.

adoption.description: Present when the framework was added to an existing repository with sdd adopt.

mode.description: advisory: checks report but never fail.

codeRoots.description: Folders scanned for @spec annotations in code.

testRoots.description: Folders whose files count as tests.

testPlan.description: Test plan to read deferred criteria from; null finds the latest docs/test/test-plan-vN.md.

docMap.description: File that holds the generated doc map.

scopeMap.description: Organizational scope map: L0 to L3 units, their parents and owners.

testResults.description: Optional JUnit XML test report; linked criteria become passing or failing.

criterionPattern.description: Optional regular expression for a richer acceptance criterion ID (for example ^(?<prefix>AM)-[A-Z]+-\d{3}-AC\d+$). The named group prefix gives the component prefix. The default <PREFIX>-<n> form is always accepted.

requireApprover.description: When true, approved documents must record approved_by and approved (date) in front matter.

components.description: Component name -> requirement ID prefix and the paths that belong to it.

scope.description: The organizational scope (a key in the scope map) the component belongs to.

features.description: Feature flags. Every optional behavior can be switched off without data loss.
